meta.title: BusinessPilot AI — business operating system
meta.description: AI, CRM, inventory and finance for entrepreneurs in Tajikistan.

landing.kicker: A decision system for entrepreneurs in Tajikistan
landing.title: Fact. Price. Simulator. Decision.
landing.subtitle: A digital twin of the business: what happened, why, what will happen, and what to do. Forecast, not a profit guarantee.
landing.f1d: Catalog, sales CSV, cash register. No marketplace scraping.
landing.f2d: Capacity, season, competitor price and promo — manual or CSV.
landing.f3d: True cost, shelf price, elasticity, “why this price”.
landing.f4d: What-if and crash test before a major decision.
landing.m1: AI agents: CEO, CFO, sales, inventory, risk
landing.m2: Stress tests: sales, costs, FX, supply
landing.m3: Decision steps: analyze → explain → simulate → recommend → learn
landing.honestTitle: What this system does and does not do
landing.honestLead: Plenty of “AI for business” tools promise what they cannot deliver. We state the limits up front.
landing.is1: Computes Health, margin and cash-flow from your catalog, cash register and CSV.
landing.is2: Proposes a shelf price per product and explains “why this price”.
landing.is3: Tests a major decision on the digital twin before you execute it.
landing.is4: Shows an estimated TJS-per-month impact on every recommendation.
landing.not1: Does not scrape live prices from Somon, OLX or Amazon.
landing.not2: Does not guarantee profit — every number is a forecast.
landing.not3: Does not run any external action without your approval.
landing.not4: Does not make the decision for you.
landing.bentoTitle: Five pillars, wired to each other
landing.agentsTitle: Seven agents, one source of numbers
landing.agentsBody: Every agent reads the same business data, so the answers do not contradict each other.
landing.pipeTitle: From a number to a decision — five steps
landing.pipeLead: This is not a chatbot. Each step consumes the output of the one before it.
landing.p1d: Reads your catalog, cash register and sales CSV. Computes Health, margin and cash-flow.
landing.p2d: Says why the number looks like that: season, thin margin, dead stock or a competitor price.
landing.p3d: Before recommending, the proposed step is run on the twin — revenue, profit, cash-flow.
landing.p4d: One concrete action lands in the Action Center with an estimated TJS-per-month impact.
landing.p5d: The decision and its result stay in business memory and shape later recommendations.
landing.priceHead: Pricing is public. No sales call required.
landing.q1q: I do not have a business yet. Is this for me?
landing.q1a: Yes. On the first step choose “No, I want to start one” — enter your budget and direction and get 3 realistic options with buy price, sell price, profit and risk.
landing.q2q: Does it pull prices from Somon or OLX?
landing.q2a: No, and that is deliberate. You enter competitor prices manually or via CSV, which makes the comparison real instead of invented.
landing.q3q: How accurate are the forecast numbers?
landing.q3a: They depend on the quality of your data. The system shows a data-completeness percentage. Profit is never guaranteed.
landing.q4q: Does the AI act on my behalf?
landing.q4a: No. The AI builds a recommendation and puts it in the Action Center. Execution happens only after you approve it.
landing.q5q: Does it work without internet or without an AI key?
landing.q5a: The core computation runs on the system’s own server. Without a Claude key the local model takes over, and the screen says so.
landing.ctaTitle: Test the big decision before you run it
landing.ctaBody: Signing up takes 2 minutes. Then the system asks whether you already have a business and builds the path from that answer.
landing.footerNote: Advice is a forecast, not a promise of profit.

preview.alertBody: 2 SKUs run out in 6 days. Estimated impact −800 TJS/month.
preview.whyBody: True cost 4,428 = buy 4,100 + freight 328. A 5,490 shelf gives 24% margin. Elasticity −0.8.
preview.simNote: Computed on the digital twin. Forecast, not a guarantee.

auth.offer: I accept the terms of use
auth.verifyHint: Enter the 6-digit code from the message.
auth.userExists: This email or phone is already registered.
auth.badCreds: Email or password is incorrect. Check the details and try again.
auth.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.badCode: The code is wrong or has expired.

onboarding.title: Your business
onboarding.subtitle: A few questions so the advice matches how you work.
onboarding.typeNote: If you chose “Other”, describe it briefly
onboarding.name: Shop or company name
onboarding.productsHint: Pick a product or fill it in yourself. Enter buy and sell prices separately.
onboarding.competitorsHint: For example: the shop next door, Somon.tj

start.q: Do you already have a business?
start.qLead: Your answer sets the path: either we analyse the running business, or we build a start plan for your budget.
start.hasYesD: Enter stock, prices and monthly numbers — the system computes Health, price and risk.
start.hasNo: No, I want to start one
start.hasNoD: Enter budget and direction — AI returns 3 realistic options with buy price, sell price and profit.
start.newLead: Write it honestly. False numbers give a false plan.
start.budgetHint: All the money you can put into the start.
start.goal: What kind of business do you want?
start.goalHint: For example: cars / parts, clothing, or fast food
start.experienceHint: For example: 2 years as a shop assistant
start.hours: How many hours per week do you have?
start.planFail: The plan was not built. Try again.
start.numbersHint: Enter at least an estimate. Without it Health and profit stay empty.
start.planPageLead: The plan AI built from your budget and city.
start.noPlan: No plan yet. Choose “No, I want to start one” in onboarding.

settings.title: Settings
settings.note: Stripe / PayMe connect at the integrations stage.
settings.aiLead: If the key fails, the system falls back to the local model. Check it here.
settings.aiInvalidPrefix: Invalid key format (must start with sk-ant-)
settings.aiHelpEnv: Set a valid Anthropic key (starting with sk-ant-) in your .env file or Vercel Environment Variables and restart `next dev`. Keys are never stored in the database.
settings.secEnc: Session is an httpOnly cookie. Password is bcrypt. External actions need human approval.
settings.currency: Currency: TJS (primary). USD/RUB are references, not live NBT rates.
settings.vat: VAT: currently 0% in cost — enter it on the product card.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.lead: First site URL or CSV. API keys and webhook (x-bp-key, JSON sku/quantity/revenue/cost) work today. Orders are not automatically pulled from WordPress/Shopify.
integrations.keysLead: A key lets your POS or script push sales and purchases automatically.
integrations.freshNote: Copy it now — the full key is never shown again.
integrations.webhookLead: Orders do not arrive automatically from WordPress/Shopify. Your POS or site must POST sales to /api/ingest/sale with x-bp-key and JSON {sku, quantity, revenue, cost}.
integrations.catalogNote: “Queued” means no automated order sync from Shopify/WooCommerce/Instagram. Real sales arrive only via webhook (/api/ingest/sale) or CSV.

intel.setupLead: Until these are filled in, the numbers stay at zero.
intel.ephemeral: On this server data is temporary. After sleep or a deploy, accounts, cash and stock can disappear.
intel.setupStore: If you have a site — save the URL. Orders are not pulled automatically.
intel.setupLearn: Complete one lesson in the business school.
intel.setup1: Add your products with buy and sell prices.
intel.setup2: Win one deal in the pipeline — it becomes a real sale.
intel.error: Data did not load. Try again.
intel.gapZeroLead: Revenue is 0 until you record a real sale. Connecting a site does not pull orders — use Manage or the pipeline.
intel.noAlerts: No new alerts — add CSV and competitor prices.
intel.dataLead: The model uses only your catalog, cash register and CSV. Somon/OLX prices are not scraped.
intel.csvHint: Sales: date,sku,quantity,revenue,cost. Stock: category,brand,model,buy,sell,qty. Competitor: name,product,price,promo,note.
intel.importFail: CSV was not read. Check headers and numbers.
intel.noScrape: There is no live marketplace scraping. That is intentional.
intel.marketLead: Capacity and trend are a city/season model, not official statistics.
intel.compLead: Enter price, SKU and promo yourself or via CSV.
intel.priceLead: True cost + recommended shelf. Click a SKU for “why this price”.
intel.whyHint: Elasticity −0.8: +10% price ≈ −8% units. This is a model.
intel.simLead: Test a major decision before you execute it. Result is a guide, not a fact.
intel.actLead: Recommend → simulate → human approval → action → result.
intel.noActions: Press “AI decision” on the dashboard first.
intel.humanGate: External actions do not run without your approval.
intel.agentLead: This is not a chatbot. Each agent answers from the same business numbers.

scan.title: City market scan
scan.lead: AI searches public web data for your city and suggests what is worth selling now. Forecast, not a guarantee. Live Somon/OLX prices are not scraped.

store.title: Connect your store
store.lead: If you have a site or online shop — paste your site URL. Orders do not arrive automatically from WordPress/Shopify.
store.leadOnline: You selected an online channel. Paste your site URL. Orders do not arrive automatically from WordPress/Shopify — only via webhook or manual entry.
store.urlHint: Use https or just the domain. Internal hosts are rejected.
store.authLead: Store admin login and password. The password is never stored as text.
store.passHint: At least 4 characters. We do not log into your WordPress/Shopify admin.
store.skippedNote: Store skipped. You can import sales via CSV or connect later.
store.connectedNote: Orders do not arrive automatically from WordPress/Shopify. Record sales and purchases in Manage or via webhook.
store.webhookHint: Send POST to the webhook with header x-bp-key and JSON: {"sku":"...","quantity":1,"revenue":1000,"cost":800}
store.unreachable: URL saved — the site did not respond
store.unreachableLead: We do not log into admin. Orders do not arrive automatically. Record buy/sell in Manage.
store.manageLead: Live orders do not arrive automatically from WordPress/Shopify. Record purchases and sales here or send via webhook.
store.whyTitle: Why didn’t it show on the panel?
store.whyLead: Saving the URL stores the domain only. We do not log into WordPress/Shopify and cannot pull orders. Record purchases below or POST to the webhook (with x-bp-key and JSON sku, quantity, revenue, cost).
store.ledgerTitle: Buy and sell from this site
store.ledgerLead: What you bought or sold on the connected site — one row here.
store.ledgerSavedBuy: Purchase went to stock and expenses. Open the panel and Finance.
store.ledgerSavedSell: Sale went to income. Refresh the panel.
store.auditLead: We do not enter admin. Only the public shop and the AI model.
store.auditFail: The calculation failed. Check the URL or try again.
store.auditEmpty: No clear products on the page.
store.auditAiBadKey: The AI key is invalid. Put an Anthropic key (sk-ant-...) in .env.
store.auditAiTimeout: AI timed out. Run the calculation again.
store.auditDisclaimer: A forecast from the public shop. Not guaranteed profit. Somon prices are not scraped.
store.successLead: Store URL and API key saved. Orders do not arrive automatically from WordPress/Shopify — record buy/sell in Manage or send to the webhook.
store.freshNote: Copy it now — the full key is never shown again.
store.secureNote: The password is hashed. We do not enter your admin panel.
store.honest: Saving the URL = site address only. We do not log into third-party admin panels (WordPress/Shopify). Send orders manually or via webhook.
